<html>
<html lang="en">
<head><title>STARC  Space Technology and Research Community</title>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@400;700;900&family=Share+Tech+Mono&family=Exo+2:wght@300;400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --cyan: #00e5ff;
    --magenta: #cc00ff;
    --gold: #c9a227;
    --saffron: #FF9933;
    --green-ind: #138808;
    --dark: #050a12;
    --panel: rgba(0,20,40,0.7);
    --panel-border: rgba(0,229,255,0.18);
    --text: #c8e6f0;
    --muted: #5a8aa0;
  }
  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  body { background:var(--dark); color:var(--text); font-family:'Exo 2',sans-serif; font-weight:300; overflow-x:hidden; }
  body::before { content:''; position:fixed; inset:0; background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,transparent 2px,rgba(0,0,0,0.025) 2px,rgba(0,0,0,0.025) 4px); pointer-events:none; z-index:9999; }
  .grid-bg { position:fixed; inset:0; background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(0,229,255,0.025) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,229,255,0.025) 1px,transparent 1px); background-size:40px 40px; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; }
  .stars { position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; }
  .star { position:absolute; width:2px; height:2px; background:white; border-radius:50%; animation:twinkle var(--d,3s) ease-in-out infinite var(--delay,0s); opacity:var(--op,0.4); }
  @keyframes twinkle { 0%,100%{opacity:var(--op,.4);transform:scale(1)} 50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.5)} }
  nav { position:fixed; top:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:100; padding:1rem 2rem; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; background:rgba(5,10,18,0.9); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--panel-border); }
  .nav-logo { font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-weight:900; font-size:1.05rem; letter-spacing:0.12em; color:#fff; text-decoration:none; }
  .nav-logo span { color:var(--cyan); }
  .nav-links { display:flex; gap:1.6rem; list-style:none; }
  .nav-links a { font-family:'Share Tech Mono',monospace; font-size:0.7rem; letter-spacing:0.16em; color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; transition:color 0.2s; }
  .nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a.active { color:var(--cyan); }
  .container { max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 2rem; position:relative; z-index:1; }
  section { padding:5.5rem 0; }
  .section-label { font-family:'Share Tech Mono',monospace; font-size:0.68rem; letter-spacing:0.35em; color:var(--cyan); margin-bottom:0.6rem; }
  .section-title { font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.5vw,2.4rem); font-weight:700; color:#fff; }
  .section-title span { color:var(--cyan); }
  .section-line { margin-top:0.9rem; height:1px; width:180px; background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--cyan),transparent); }
  .section-header { margin-bottom:3rem; }
  .panel { background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--panel-border); }
  .stat-val { font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:1.7rem; font-weight:900; color:var(--cyan); line-height:1; }
  .stat-lbl { font-family:'Share Tech Mono',monospace; font-size:0.62rem; letter-spacing:0.14em; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; margin-top:0.25rem; }
  .btn { font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:0.75rem; letter-spacing:0.1em; font-weight:700; padding:0.8rem 2rem; text-decoration:none; display:inline-block; transition:all 0.2s; cursor:pointer; clip-path:polygon(10px 0%,100% 0%,calc(100% - 10px) 100%,0% 100%); }
  .btn-primary { color:var(--dark); background:var(--cyan); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background:#fff; }
  .btn-outline { color:var(--cyan); border:1px solid var(--cyan); background:transparent; }
  .btn-outline:hover { background:rgba(0,229,255,0.08); }
  .btn-gold { color:var(--dark); background:var(--gold); }
  .btn-gold:hover { background:var(--saffron); }
  footer { border-top:1px solid var(--panel-border); padding:2.5rem 0; text-align:center; }
  .footer-logo { font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:900; color:#fff; margin-bottom:0.4rem; }
  .footer-logo span { color:var(--cyan); }
  .footer-sub { font-family:'Share Tech Mono',monospace; font-size:0.65rem; letter-spacing:0.22em; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:1.5rem; }
  .footer-links { display:flex; gap:1.8rem; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:1.2rem; }
  .footer-links a { font-family:'Share Tech Mono',monospace; font-size:0.7rem; letter-spacing:0.14em; color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; transition:color 0.2s; }
  .footer-links a:hover { color:var(--cyan); }
  .footer-copy { font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--muted); }
  @keyframes fadeUp { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
  @keyframes blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.25} }
  @media(max-width:700px){ .nav-links{display:none} }
</style>
<style>
.hero{ min-height:100vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; align-items:center; text-align:center; padding:7rem 2rem 4rem; }
.hero-emblem{ width:130px; height:130px; margin-bottom:2rem; animation:spin-slow 22s linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin-slow{ from{transform:rotate(0deg)} to{transform:rotate(360deg)} }
.hero-tag{ font-family:'Share Tech Mono',monospace; font-size:0.72rem; letter-spacing:0.3em; color:var(--cyan); margin-bottom:0.8rem; animation:fadeUp 1s ease 0.3s both; }
.hero-title{ font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:clamp(3.5rem,10vw,7rem); font-weight:900; letter-spacing:0.06em; line-height:1; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 30%,var(--cyan) 80%); -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text; animation:fadeUp 1s ease 0.5s both; }
.hero-sub{ font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:clamp(0.8rem,2vw,1.1rem); font-weight:400; color:var(--gold); letter-spacing:0.22em; margin:0.6rem 0 1.8rem; animation:fadeUp 1s ease 0.7s both; }
.hero-desc{ max-width:560px; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.85; color:var(--text); margin-bottom:2.5rem; animation:fadeUp 1s ease 0.9s both; }
.hero-cta{ display:flex; gap:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:2.5rem; animation:fadeUp 1s ease 1.1s both; }
.mission-cards{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:1.8rem; }
.mission-card{ background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--panel-border); padding:2.2rem; text-decoration:none; display:block; transition:border-color 0.2s,transform 0.2s; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
.mission-card::before{ content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,229,255,0.04) 0%,transparent 60%); }
.mission-card:hover{ border-color:rgba(0,229,255,0.5); transform:translateY(-4px); }
.mission-card.gold:hover{ border-color:rgba(255,153,0,0.5); }
.mission-card.gold::before{ background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,153,0,0.04) 0%,transparent 60%); }
.mc-label{ font-family:'Share Tech Mono',monospace; font-size:0.65rem; letter-spacing:0.2em; color:var(--cyan); margin-bottom:0.5rem; }
.mc-label.orange{ color:var(--saffron); }
.mc-title{ font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:1.4rem; font-weight:700; color:#fff; margin-bottom:0.7rem; }
.mc-desc{ font-size:0.88rem; line-height:1.75; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:1.2rem; }
.mc-stats{ display:flex; gap:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.mc-stat{ font-family:'Share Tech Mono',monospace; font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--text); }
.mc-stat strong{ color:var(--cyan); font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif; font-size:0.9rem; }
.mc-stat.or strong{ color:var(--saffron); }
.mc-arrow{ position:absolute; bottom:1.5rem; right:1.5rem; font-family:'Share Tech Mono',monospace; font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--cyan); letter-spacing:0.1em; }
.mc-arrow.orange{ color:var(--saffron); }
.stats-row{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:1.2rem; }
.stat-box{ background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--panel-border); padding:1.5rem; text-align:center; border-left:3px solid var(--cyan); }
.stat-box.gold{ border-left-color:var(--gold); }
.stat-box.magenta{ border-left-color:var(--magenta); }
.stat-box.saffron{ border-left-color:var(--saffron); }
@media(max-width:700px){ .mission-cards,.stats-row{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="stars" id="stars"></div>
<div class="grid-bg"></div>
<nav>
  <a href="index.html" class="nav-logo" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.55rem;"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="STARC" style="border-radius:50%;width:28px;height:28px;object-fit:contain"/>STARC<span>.</span></a>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="index.html" class='active'>Home</a></li>
    <li><a href="vajra.html" >Vajra</a></li>
    <li><a href="kalpana.html" >Mission Kalpana</a></li>
    <li><a href="team.html" >Team</a></li>
    <li><a href="mailto:istc.starc.iiitd@gmail.com">Contact</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<div class="hero">
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="STARC Logo" style="border-radius:50%;width:130px;height:130px;object-fit:contain;animation:spin-slow 22s linear infinite"/>
  <p class="hero-tag">// IIIT DELHI · SPACE TECHNOLOGY AND RESEARCH COMMUNITY</p>
  <h1 class="hero-title">STARC</h1>
  <p class="hero-sub">ENGINEERING TOMORROW'S ROCKETS TODAY</p>
  <p class="hero-desc">India's next-generation student rocketry team from IIIT Delhi  designing, simulating, and launching high-power rockets while pushing the boundaries of aerospace research.</p>
  <div class="hero-cta">
    <a href="vajra.html" class="btn btn-primary">Our Rockets</a>
    <a href="team.html" class="btn btn-outline">Meet the Team</a>
  </div>
</div>

<section style="padding-top:2rem;">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header reveal">
      <p class="section-label">// ACTIVE MISSIONS</p>
      <h2 class="section-title">Our <span>Vehicles</span></h2>
      <div class="section-line"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="mission-cards">
      <a href="vajra.html" class="mission-card reveal">
        <div class="mc-label">// MISSION 01 · COMPLETED</div>
        <div class="mc-title">VAJRA</div>
        <div class="mc-desc">Active canard-controlled high-power rocket carrying a CANSAT payload for gravity variation measurement. STARC's first flight vehicle.</div>
        <div class="mc-stats">
          <div class="mc-stat"><strong>~1003 m</strong><br>Apogee</div>
          <div class="mc-stat"><strong>140 m/s</strong><br>Peak Vel.</div>
          <div class="mc-stat"><strong>1.64 cal</strong><br>Stability</div>
        </div>
        <div class="mc-arrow">EXPLORE →</div>
      </a>
      <a href="kalpana.html" class="mission-card gold reveal">
        <div class="mc-label orange">// MISSION 02 · IN DEVELOPMENT</div>
        <div class="mc-title" style="color:var(--saffron);">MISSION KALPANA</div>
        <div class="mc-desc">Passively stabilized ITR-1 rocket named in honour of Kalpana Chawla. Faster, higher, and simpler by design.</div>
        <div class="mc-stats">
          <div class="mc-stat or"><strong>1075 m</strong><br>Apogee</div>
          <div class="mc-stat or"><strong>Mach 0.511</strong><br>Peak Mach</div>
          <div class="mc-stat or"><strong>K1800ST</strong><br>Motor</div>
        </div>
        <div class="mc-arrow orange">EXPLORE →</div>
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section style="background:rgba(0,10,25,0.5);border-top:1px solid var(--panel-border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--panel-border);">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header reveal">
      <p class="section-label">// BY THE NUMBERS</p>
      <h2 class="section-title">STARC <span>at a Glance</span></h2>
      <div class="section-line"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stats-row">
      <div class="stat-box reveal">
        <div class="stat-val">2</div>
        <div class="stat-lbl">Rockets Built</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-box gold reveal">
        <div class="stat-val" style="color:var(--gold);">1075 m</div>
        <div class="stat-lbl">Max Simulated Apogee</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-box magenta reveal">
        <div class="stat-val" style="color:var(--magenta);">1</div>
        <div class="stat-lbl">GLEX Publication</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-box saffron reveal">
        <div class="stat-val" style="color:var(--saffron);">20+</div>
        <div class="stat-lbl">Team Members</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <div class="container" style="text-align:center;">
    <div class="reveal">
      <p class="section-label" style="justify-content:center;display:block;">// GET INVOLVED</p>
      <h2 class="section-title" style="margin-bottom:1rem;">Join <span>STARC</span></h2>
      <p style="max-width:480px;margin:0 auto 2rem;font-size:0.95rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);">We're always looking for passionate engineers, scientists, and builders. If you're at IIIT Delhi and want to build rockets, reach out.</p>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <a href="mailto:istc.starc.iiitd@gmail.com" class="btn btn-primary">Get in Touch</a>
        <a href="team.html" class="btn btn-outline">Meet the Team</a>
        <a href="https://www.instagram.com/starc_iiitd/" target="_blank" class="btn btn-outline">Instagram</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>
  <div class="container">
    <div class="footer-logo" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.7rem;margin-bottom:0.6rem;"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="STARC" style="border-radius:50%;width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:contain"/>STARC<span>.</span></div>
    <div class="footer-sub">SPACE TECHNOLOGY AND RESEARCH COMMUNITY · IIIT DELHI</div>
    <div class="footer-links">
      <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/starc-iiitd/posts/?feedView=all" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a>
      <a href="https://www.instagram.com/starc_iiitd/" target="_blank">Instagram</a>
      <a href="vajra.html">Vajra</a>
      <a href="kalpana.html">Mission Kalpana</a>
      <a href="team.html">Team</a>
      <a href="mailto:istc.starc.iiitd@gmail.com">istc.starc.iiitd@gmail.com</a>
    </div>
    <div class="footer-copy">© 2025 STARC  IIIT Delhi · Built for the stars.</div>
  </div>
</footer>
<script>
const s=document.getElementById('stars');
for(let i=0;i<160;i++){
  const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='star';
  const x=Math.random()*100,y=Math.random()*100;
  const d=(2+Math.random()*4).toFixed(1),delay=(Math.random()*5).toFixed(1),op=(0.2+Math.random()*0.55).toFixed(2);
  el.style.cssText=`left:${x}%;top:${y}%;--d:${d}s;--delay:-${delay}s;--op:${op}`;
  if(Math.random()>.87){el.style.width=el.style.height='3px';el.style.background=Math.random()>.5?'#00e5ff':'#c9a227';el.style.opacity='0.25';}
  s.appendChild(el);
}
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>{
  el.style.opacity='0';el.style.transform='translateY(20px)';el.style.transition='opacity 0.55s ease,transform 0.55s ease';
  new IntersectionObserver(([e])=>{if(e.isIntersecting){el.style.opacity='1';el.style.transform='translateY(0)';}},{threshold:0.08}).observe(el);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
